note: Gold value per stat point for the shop's gold efficiency (C7/FEATURE-GAP 5.3). Stats that have a single-stat basic item (or boots: msFlat) are derived from that item at runtime (src/ui/goldEfficiency.ts); these are the reference values for stats without one, from the LoL wiki method (14.x), scaled to Veilgrounds basic-item prices where a LoL counterpart exists.
